name: Eldritch Idol
source:
Some time after being fired from their idol agency, You (name changeable) stumbles upon a cute young girl with big, big dreams. She introduces herself as Cthulhu (aka Kuku), a Great Old One from the underwater ruins of R'lyeh. For many years, Kuku has whiled away her long, long life dreaming...

But, during this time, her dedicated following has dwindled down to almost nothing!

Determined to revitalize her cult and regain a brand new slew of worshippers, Kuku comes up with a masterful plan: namely, that she'll become an adorable idol and conquer the world through her singing, her dancing, and her charm! Work with Kuku as her producer to manage her schedule, raise her stats, and make decisions that will shape the trajectory of her career. Don't let her get too stressed, though: otherwise, the world might come to a watery end.

[Edited from [url=https://ebihime.itch.io/eldritch-idol]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在被偶像经纪公司解雇一段时间后，尤（化名）偶然发现了一个有着远大梦想的可爱年轻女孩。她介绍自己为克苏鲁（又名库库），一位来自拉莱耶水下废墟的旧日支配者。多年来，库库一直在消磨着她漫长的人生梦想……

但是，在这段时间里，她的忠实追随者已经减少到几乎为零！

库库决心重振她的邪教并重新获得一批全新的崇拜者，她想出了一个绝妙的计划：那就是，她将成为一个可爱的偶像，并通过她的歌声、她的舞蹈和她的魅力征服世界！与作为制作人的Kuku一起管理她的日程、提高她的统计数据并做出将塑造她职业轨迹的决定。不过，不要让她压力太大：否则，世界可能会走向末日。

[编辑自[url=https://ebihime.itch.io/eldritch-idol]Itch.io[/url]]
